messages:
Priya N: Quick sync  scheduling a midnight roll for `ff:cohort-fastpath` with model v3.2 at 00:30 UTC. Regional phased enable: EU -> NA -> APAC. Ramp: 2% -> 15% -> 60% -> 100%. Soak: EU 8m, NA 25m, APAC 20m. Runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/cohort-fastpath-2026

Liam G: We'll keep v2 pinned in APAC until APAC hits 60%. For EU/NA unpin at 15% after soak. If any gate trips we fallback to pinned version.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by Priya N at 2026-03-22T00:30:00Z. Canary eu-west-1 (2%). Health checks at +5m and +8m.

oncall-bot: Telemetry gates configured: p95_latency, request_error_rate, 99th_token_latency. Circuit-breaker: if error_rate > 1.25% OR p95 > baseline + 180ms for 2 consecutive 5m windows, auto-set region pct=0 and re-pin to v2. Will page oncall.

Ops: Exclude cohorts `internal_*` and `perf_test_*`. Use `--exclude-cohorts internal_* --exclude-cohorts perf_test_*` in toggle. Also ensure KV cache warming plan is on standby.

Priya N: Runbook CLI snippets:
```
/ff toggle cohort-fastpath --region eu --pct 2 --exclude-cohorts internal_* --exclude-cohorts perf_test_*
/ff toggle cohort-fastpath --region eu --pct 15
/ff toggle cohort-fastpath --pct 0 --pin v2 --reason "auto-rollback or manual"
```

Liam G: Suggest NA soak at 30m at 15% (NA high qps). Accept EU 8m, NA 30m, APAC 20m.

Priya N: Accepted. Manual rollback window 00:40-01:30 UTC. Release notes draft: "cohort-fastpath (v3.2) phased regional rollout to reduce p95; pinned fallback to v2 for APAC until 60% stable. Auto-rollback rules in place."

deploy-bot: Deploy started. Canary EU at 2%. First 5m check scheduled.

(End of thread)
